name: tpl-precedence-3-goal
task: Pick up the box in the other room, but do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) is the hard command to pick up the box. Precedence(door_open, key_lost) matches "do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once" because the "until" wording makes it a Precedence even though key_lost already includes a closed-door condition. Compiler clues show no redundant clauses, and the machine rejects an early key drop while accepting the box pickup.

texts: Pick up the box in the other room (the mission's target box must be picked up).
Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once: the key-lost event may not happen before the door has been opened.
